## Done — image is ready

**`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the one view in your workspace, rendered as a C4 System Context diagram.

Your `workspace.dsl` defines a single view (`systemContext library "SystemContext"`), so there's exactly one image. It shows:
- **Patron** `[Person]` → **Library** `[System]`, relationship *"Browses the catalogue through"* `[HTTPS]`
- Canonical C4 colors, icons, and a legend (Person / Software System / Container / Component / Database / Queue)

### Why SVG and not PNG
This environment has **no network access** (DNS fails, direct IPs are unreachable, and the sandboxed `fetch` is blocked) and **no local renderers** (no PlantUML/Java, Node, Python, Graphviz, or ImageMagick). I parsed and validated the DSL, exported the view to C4-PlantUML, and then hand-built a faithful C4-style **SVG** (which you explicitly allowed). A PNG isn't possible here without a rasterizer/encoder.

If you'd like, I can also drop the intermediate **`SystemContext.puml`** (C4-PlantUML source) into the directory so you can render it to PNG anywhere PlantUML is available — just say the word.
